sk.metrics:area: Area of the field, in square meters (m²). Must be > 0 and <= 1,000,000,000. ([spec](https://github.com/fiboa/specification/blob/main/core/README.md))
sk.municipality: Municipality (source column `LOKALITA_N`, per the fiboa data survey)

wri_trazo_ml.basemap: Source-specific column; the publisher documents no meaning for it.
wri_trazo_ml.bbox: The bounding box of the field. Per-feature covering column (GeoParquet 1.1), in the source CRS. ([spec](https://github.com/fiboa/specification/blob/main/core/README.md))
wri_trazo_ml.determination:datetime: The last timestamp at which the field did exist and was observed. ([spec](https://github.com/fiboa/specification/blob/main/core/README.md))
wri_trazo_ml.geometry: A geometry that reflects the footprint of the field, usually a Polygon. Stored in the source CRS (see `proj:code`), not reprojected. ([spec](https://github.com/fiboa/specification/blob/main/core/README.md))
wri_trazo_ml.metrics:area: Area of the field, in square meters (m²). Must be > 0 and <= 1,000,000,000. ([spec](https://github.com/fiboa/specification/blob/main/core/README.md))
wri_trazo_ml.region: Source-specific column; the publisher documents no meaning for it.
wri_trazo_ml.split: Source-specific column; the publisher documents no meaning for it.

za_fusion_ml.crop:code: The crop code, from the code list of the source. ([spec](https://github.com/fiboa/crop-extension/blob/main/README.md))
